prompt: The camera does not move. Brandon sits hunched on the stair with the phone held close, then pushes both palms on his knees and stands up in one decisive motion, his brow set, jaw tight, eyes fixed on the front door below. Later he settles his weight onto his front foot and glances once towards the door with his eyelids narrowed. The bare bulb on the landing flickers faintly. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so fast movement smears. The camera does not move. Audio: a bulb buzzing, a trainer squeaking on a stair tread, the creak of the banister, a distant television through a wall. No dialogue, no music. Thanks.
